reviews.snippet:
> Very bad experience at Asian City Hospital. Staff behaviour is very rude, nobody gives proper answer. Doctors do not take full responsibility / risk of operation, they just say get operated tomorrow without explaining complications. They did all costly tests like ECG, X-ray, MRI in the name of operation. I decided not to get operated here and went to AIIMS. I will not recommend this hospital to anyone for spine surgery.

> Staff Behaviour - 1/5
> Doctor Clarity - 1/5
> Yahan sirf paisa banane ka kaam hota hai. "Kal operation posted hai, NPO raho" bol ke pressure banate hain. Jab maine patient review liya to sab ro rahe the operation ke baad bhi. Doctor khud apne operation ki guarantee nahi lete. Ayushman par bhi yahi haal hai. Kripya yahan spine ka bada operation na karayein, pehle AIIMS Patna ya IGIMS me second opinion zaroor le lein.

reviews.snippet:
First of all, thanks for the hospitality... but there is a lack of transparency at the hospital. They use the Ayushman card primarily to make money; they refuse to provide an itemized bill when asked. Even though all check-ups are covered by the card, they charge fees beforehand; then, they discharge and re-admit the patient just to generate more revenue.
If the actual cost is around ₹1 lakh, the hospital gets an inflated estimate approved to extract more money. I experienced this firsthand; when I asked the 'Manager on Duty' (MOD) for the Ayushman bill, they refused. Initially, the staff quoted a certain amount, but when the approval came through and I checked the app, I was shocked to see that the hospital management had secured approval for exactly double that amount. This hospital is solely focused on making money by misleading the government and the public... a terrible experience

reviews.snippet:
Hospital facilities are good, and the doctors and staff are supportive. However, a few improvements could make the patient experience even better:

- An additional Ayushman Help Desk would help reduce waiting time.
- More seating arrangements should be provided for patients' attendants.
- An emergency support counter at the Ayushman Desk would make the admission process faster during emergencies.

Overall, it was a good experience, and I hope these suggestions will help the hospital improve its services further.
